transition_notes: Supreme law of the Republic of India; provides Fundamental Rights (Part III) enforceable through High Courts (Art 226) and Supreme Court (Art 32).

long_title: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act No. 45 of 2023)
transition_notes: In force from 1 July 2024. Governs substantive criminal offences committed on or after 1 July 2024. Replaces Indian Penal Code, 1860.

long_title: The Indian Penal Code (Act No. 45 of 1860)
transition_notes: Repealed by BNS 2023 effective 1 July 2024. Retains legal force and applies to criminal proceedings and trials for offences committed prior to 1 July 2024 under Section 358 BNS / General Clauses Act Sec 6.

long_title: The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act No. 46 of 2023)
transition_notes: In force from 1 July 2024. Replaces the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973. Mandates zero-FIR, digital evidence recording, time-bound investigations, and victim rights.

long_title: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Act No. 2 of 1974)
transition_notes: Repealed by BNSS 2023 effective 1 July 2024. Pending investigations, inquiries, and trials instituted prior to 1 July 2024 continue under CrPC.

long_title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Act No. 35 of 2019)
transition_notes: Replaced CPA 1986. Establishes Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA), e-filing (edaakhil.nic.in), product liability, and pecuniary jurisdiction for District/State/National Commissions.

long_title: The Information Technology Act, 2000 (Act No. 21 of 2000)
transition_notes: Key sections amended by IT Amendment Act 2008. Covers computer source tampering, hacking, cheating by personation, identity theft, and privacy violation.

long_title: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act No. 22 of 2023)
transition_notes: Establishes Data Protection Board of India, imposes obligations on Data Fiduciaries, and grants rights to Data Principals for processing digital personal data.

long_title: The Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (Act No. 59 of 1988)
transition_notes: Significantly amended by Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2019 regarding enhanced compensation for hit-and-run, Golden Hour medical treatment, and strict penalties.

long_title: The Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 (Act No. 26 of 1881)
transition_notes: Section 138 penalizes dishonour of cheques for insufficiency of funds. Strict limitation: legal demand notice must be dispatched within 30 days of receipt of return memo.

long_title: The Transfer of Property Act, 1882 (Act No. 4 of 1882)
transition_notes: Governs leases of immovable property (Section 105 to 111), rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee, determination of leases, and notice requirements.

long_title: The Code on Wages, 2019 (Act No. 29 of 2019)
transition_notes: Subsumes Payment of Wages Act 1936, Minimum Wages Act 1948, Payment of Bonus Act 1965, and Equal Remuneration Act 1976.

short_title: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
long_title: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 (Act No. 43 of 2005)
transition_notes: Provides civil protection orders, residence orders, monetary relief, and custody orders for aggrieved women in domestic relationships.

short_title: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009
long_title: The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 (Act No. 35 of 2009)
transition_notes: Gives statutory effect to Article 21A of the Constitution; prohibits screening procedures, capitation fees, physical punishment, and mental harassment in schools.

long_title: The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 (Act No. 39 of 1987)
transition_notes: Constitutes NALSA, State Legal Services Authorities, District Legal Services Authorities, and Lok Adalats to ensure equal justice under Article 39A of Constitution.
